items.title: Tom Baker interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: Its main claim to fame was that Dave Brubeck went there.

ctx.x: Did you start playing pretty quickly when you got there?

Yeah. Almost right away. The thing was I was enrolled in a conservatory here in Stockton, California, called the University of the Pacific. Its main claim to fame was that Dave Brubeck went there. So after going there for six months, after junior college, the parents announced one day to my brother and I that we were going to emigrate to Australia. We said yeah, that’s fine. And a few months later, there we went. We’d sold the farm, we had a farm with milk cows and all of that. We sold the farm and down we went.…
What was the reason for it?
